text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day before Satono Diamond ran in her 
first GⅠ race, she received an encouraging 
phone call from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond respected her parents for 
everything they had contributed to the 
Umamusume world. That was why she wanted 
to deliver a GⅠ victory to them.
